zh-CN.title: Agent 团队
zh-CN.description: 让多个 Agent 围绕同一个目标协作，共享进展，交接任务。

usage.title: 组建你的团队
usage.description: 选择 2–8 个已有的自定义 Agent，给团队命名，并设定共同目标。

usage.title: 用 @ 分配任务
usage.description: 在团队对话中输入 @ 并选择成员，再发送任务；成员会在各自的会话中处理。

usage.title: 查看进展与成果
usage.description: 在活动记录中查看成员回复和交接；展开任务可打开成员会话、处理提问或下载成果。

requirements: 至少准备 2 个自定义 Agent；如限制了工具分组，需要允许 extensions。

en-US.title: Agent teams
en-US.description: Bring Agents together around a shared goal, share progress and hand off tasks.

usage.title: Build your team
usage.description: Choose 2–8 existing Custom Agents, name your team and set a shared goal.

usage.title: Delegate with @mentions
usage.description: Type @ and select members in the team composer, then send a task to their own conversations.

usage.title: Review progress and results
usage.description: Read replies and handoffs in the activity feed. Expand a task to open its conversation, answer questions or download results.

requirements: Prepare at least two Custom Agents; allow the extensions tool group if using a tool-group allowlist.
